info.name: red-bank Backend
info.description: Postman collection for the API requests currently implemented in the red-bank backend. Each request uses the base URL of its owning microservice. Public business APIs use the shared context/data envelope. Internal APIs use X-Internal-Service-Token. Debug endpoints require the develop profile and REDBANK_DEBUG_ENABLED=true. Gateway key exchange requires REDBANK_GATEWAY_APP_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true.

request.description: Conditional gateway endpoint. Enable REDBANK_GATEWAY_APP_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true before calling.
Creates a user and returns a limited onboarding token. The collection test stores it as onboardingToken.
Returns either a user token or a device verification challenge. The collection test stores challengeId as deviceChallengeId and the limited token as deviceVerifyToken.
Uses the login challenge token. In develop, otpCode=111111 works only when REDBANK_DEBUG_MOCK_OTP_ENABLED=true.
Creates the personal profile and default saving account. The collection test stores profileId, accountNumber, and iban.
Only succeeds when the ledger-backed balance is zero.
Reopens an owned closed account and reactivates the owning profile.
Creates an additional profile. The service currently limits users to five profiles.
Edits profile display name and image. Send image:null to clear the current profile image.
Lists cards owned by the authenticated user and selected profile, with optional status and account-number filters.
